annotations.title: Private file storage for agents (long-term memory)

description: Store files privately for the paying wallet (or card pack): only that payer can list or download them. action=store with bytes=<size> first returns the exact price (402): $0.005 per MB, min $0.005, kept 30 days; action=renew adds 30 days at the same price. download $0.005 any size; list, info, delete $0.002. Upload by POST (raw bytes, or JSON {data_base64}); max 95 MB per file. Downloads are raw bytes, or format=base64 for JSON (up to 20 MB). The price depends on the inputs, as described above (USDC on Base, x402); you're only charged when the call succeeds.

action.description: store, download, renew, info, list, or delete

bytes.description: File size in bytes (store/renew; sets the price)

name.description: File name to keep with it (store)

name: file
